groups.title: Typed denominal VNC domain
groups.proposal: Build finite VNCs from typed nominal Sources through one licensed denominal operation.
groups.readingJob: Show Source, verbalization, participant projection, class, boundary, and finite Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Source and licensed operation are choices; class, boundary, and participant effects are derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not authorize from lesson, formula, surface, or stored answer.

groups.title: Inceptive and stative suffixes
groups.proposal: Apply ti, hui, ya, ā, and huā inceptive/stative routes with typed root/stem rank, class, and boundary behavior.
groups.readingJob: Show suffix family, root or stem rank, class, ya behavior, perfective, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Only genuinely licensed route/class alternatives are selectable.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not infer the suffix route from the final spelling.

groups.title: Included-possessor ti verbstems
groups.proposal: Project included possessor participants from exact possessive NNC Sources into denominal ti VNCs.
groups.readingJob: Show possessor Source, family, projected participant, valence, class, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Possessor choice belongs to the Source; its VNC role is derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not add or remove an included possessor through hidden state.

groups.title: Intransitive ti of possession
groups.proposal: Distinguish possession ti from inceptive/stative ti using typed Source semantics and participant projection.
groups.readingJob: Show possession profile, Source state, class, participants, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: The semantic operation is a genuine choice only where both routes remain licensed.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not merge homophonous ti routes by spelling.

groups.title: First-type causatives from ti verbstems
groups.proposal: Continue exact ti Results into lia, a, ia, tla, and licensed single/double-object causative structures.
groups.readingJob: Show upstream ti identity, causative route, object projection, class/boundary changes, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Causative route is selectable; new objects follow the canonical participant graph.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not reconstruct an upstream ti Result or supply caller object authority.

groups.title: First-type applicatives from ti verbstems
groups.proposal: Continue licensed intransitive ti Results into applicative structures while preserving Source identity and valence history.
groups.readingJob: Show upstream ti Result, applicative route, new object, class, boundary, and finite Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Applicative route is available only for compatible exact Results.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not authorize continuation from a copied operation frame.
